summary: A strong theory-and-methods day for heavy-ion physics: a 4D lattice-constrained critical equation of state, fluctuation-based viscosity validation, magnetized-QGP dilepton phenomenology, and a coupled conserved-charge diffusion benchmark. The strongest AI/ML work uses QCD structure or controlled evaluation to address HEP reliability rather than applying generic models.
strongest_paper_summary: The 4D T′-expanded lattice-QCD plus 3D-Ising equation of state is the most important heavy-ion theory contribution because it makes critical behavior configurable in the full BQS thermodynamic space needed by realistic hydrodynamic studies.

papers.title: A 4D T′-expanded lattice QCD equation of state with a multi-dimensional 3D-Ising-type critical contribution
papers.authors: Francesco Di Clemente, Prachi Garella, Johannes Jahan, Micheal Kahangirwe, Jamie M. Karthein, Jacquelyn Noronha-Hostler, Claudia Ratti, Mikhail Stephanov
papers.abstract: A four-dimensional equation of state in (T, muB, muQ, muS) combines the lattice 4D T′-Expansion Scheme with a 3D-Ising critical contribution and a parametrizable critical surface.

papers.title: Shear viscosity from fluctuations in linearized relativistic hydrodynamics
papers.authors: Jakub Sterba, Iurii Karpenko, Marlene Nahrgang, Boris Tomasik
papers.abstract: Linearized vHLLE simulations use fluctuation-dissipation noise, static structure factors, and Green-Kubo extraction; the recovered viscosity matches the input and common regulators spoil the fluctuation spectrum.

papers.title: Virtual photon bremsstrahlung in a magnetized quark-gluon-plasma
papers.authors: Aritra Bandyopadhyay, Krzysztof Redlich, Chihiro Sasaki
papers.abstract: An LPM dilepton calculation in a magnetized QGP finds that the leading magnetic-field dependence enters through Landau-level changes to density and Debye screening.

papers.title: Conserved-charge diffusion in hot and dense QCD matter
papers.authors: Dushmanta Sahu, Kangkan Goswami, Raghunath Sahoo
papers.abstract: A three-flavor NJL relaxation-time calculation evaluates the full coupled diffusion matrix for baryon number, electric charge, and strangeness at finite density.

papers.title: HEPTABench: A framework for portable and controlled agentic evaluations in high energy physics
papers.authors: Tony Menzo, Alexander Roman, George T. Fleming, Sergei Gleyzer, Konstantin Matchev, Stephen Mrenna
papers.abstract: A reproducible framework separates HEP tasks, tools, models, harnesses, and artifacts; controlled campaigns show domain tools can improve long-lived-particle and symbolic decay tasks.

papers.title: RINO: Renormalization Group Distillation with No Labels
papers.authors: Zichun Hao, Raghav Kansal, Abhijith Gandrakota, Chang Sun, Haoyang Li, Zihan Zhao, Ngadiuba Jennifer, Javier Duarte, Maria Spiropulu
papers.abstract: Renormalization-group-inspired hierarchical jet views support self-distillation on unlabeled QCD jets and improve OOD transfer to top and Higgs jet classes.

papers.title: Using Line Segment Tracking to enable ML-based Track Reconstruction in CMS
papers.authors: Aashay Arora on behalf of the CMS Collaboration
papers.abstract: A geometry-aware Transformer and object condensation on line-segment objects achieves comparable efficiency with about three times lower fake rate than an LST quintuplet baseline at pileup 200.
